name: NEET-UG
purpose: National entrance test for MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, veterinary and some nursing seats
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English; minimum age 17
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: Tamil Nadu MBBS/BDS counselling (DME Selection Committee)
conducted_by: Selection Committee, Directorate of Medical Education, Tamil Nadu
purpose: Allots state-quota MBBS and BDS seats in Tamil Nadu using NEET-UG scores; 7.5% of seats are reserved for government school students
eligibility: Qualified NEET-UG; Tamil Nadu nativity rules apply for state quota
fee_note: Government college fees are low; verify on portal

name: Tamil Nadu paramedical and nursing admission (DME counselling)
conducted_by: Selection Committee, Directorate of Medical Education, Tamil Nadu
purpose: Merit-based admission to nursing, pharmacy, physiotherapy, optometry, radiology, lab technology and other paramedical degree and diploma courses
eligibility: Class 12 marks (usually Physics, Chemistry, Biology; some courses accept other groups); merit list, no separate entrance exam for most courses
fee_note: Government college fees are low; verify on portal

name: JEE Main
purpose: Admission to NITs, IIITs and other engineering colleges; qualifying step for JEE Advanced (IITs)
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD and girls; verify on portal

name: TNEA (Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions)
conducted_by: Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE), Tamil Nadu
purpose: Single-window counselling for B.E./B.Tech seats in Tamil Nadu based on Class 12 marks, with 7.5% preferential reservation for government school students
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics; no entrance exam, merit on Class 12 marks
fee_note: Registration fee is lower for SC/SCA/ST; verify on portal

name: CUET-UG
purpose: Admission to undergraduate courses in central universities and many other participating universities
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream; subject choice depends on the course you want
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: TNGASA (Tamil Nadu Government Arts and Science College admission)
conducted_by: Department of Collegiate Education, Government of Tamil Nadu
purpose: Online merit-based admission to B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., BBA and BCA seats in government arts and science colleges
eligibility: Class 12 pass; merit on Class 12 marks with Tamil Nadu reservation
fee_note: Very low application fee; verify on portal

name: Tamil Nadu polytechnic diploma admission
conducted_by: Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE), Tamil Nadu
purpose: Merit-based admission to 3-year diploma courses in government and aided polytechnic colleges; lateral entry to second year for Class 12 / ITI holders
eligibility: Class 10 pass for first year; Class 12 (vocational/science) or ITI for lateral entry
fee_note: Government polytechnic fees are low; verify on portal

name: Tamil Nadu Government ITI admission
conducted_by: Department of Employment and Training, Government of Tamil Nadu
purpose: Online admission to 1-2 year NCVT/SCVT trade courses (electrician, fitter, welder, mechanic, COPA, etc.) in government and private ITIs
eligibility: Class 8 or Class 10 depending on the trade; minimum age 14
fee_note: Government ITIs are free and trainees get a monthly stipend and free kit; verify current amounts on portal

name: All India Trade Test (AITT) for ITI trainees
conducted_by: Directorate General of Training (DGT), Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
purpose: Final exam for ITI trainees; passing gives the National Trade Certificate (NTC) accepted for jobs and apprenticeships
eligibility: Enrolled ITI trainee who completed the trade course
typical_month: End of each training year (verify on portal)
fee_note: Paid through the ITI; verify on portal

name: NCHM JEE
purpose: Admission to B.Sc Hospitality and Hotel Administration at Institutes of Hotel Management (IHMs)
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream with English
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: NIFT entrance exam
purpose: Admission to B.Des (fashion, textile, accessory design) and B.FTech at NIFT campuses including Chennai
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream for B.Des; age limits apply; verify on portal
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: NID DAT (Design Aptitude Test)
purpose: Admission to B.Des at NID campuses (communication, textile, product, animation design)
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream; age limits apply
fee_note: Fee concession for some categories; verify on portal

name: CLAT (Common Law Admission Test)
purpose: Admission to 5-year integrated LLB at National Law Universities
eligibility: Class 12 in any stream with at least 45% (40% for SC/ST)
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/BPL; verify on portal

name: Tamil Nadu law admission (TNDALU)
conducted_by: The Tamil Nadu Dr. Ambedkar Law University
purpose: Merit-based admission to 5-year and 3-year LLB courses at the university and government law colleges in Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Class 12 for 5-year LLB; a degree for 3-year LLB; merit on marks, no national entrance test
fee_note: Government law college fees are low; verify on portal

name: CA Foundation
conducted_by: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
purpose: First level of the Chartered Accountancy course
eligibility: Register after Class 10; appear after passing Class 12 (any stream, commerce helps)
typical_month: More than once a year; verify on portal
fee_note: Registration and exam fees apply; verify on portal

name: TNPSC Group 4 (Combined Civil Services Exam IV)
purpose: Recruitment to Junior Assistant, Typist, Bill Collector, VAO and similar state government posts
eligibility: Class 10 (SSLC) pass; age 18+; Tamil eligibility test is compulsory; typist posts need typewriting certificate
typical_month: Notification early in the year, exam mid-year (verify on portal)
fee_note: Exam fee exemption for some categories for limited attempts; verify on portal

name: TNPSC VAO (Village Administrative Officer, part of Group 4)
purpose: Recruitment of Village Administrative Officers, now selected through the Group 4 exam
eligibility: Class 10 (SSLC) pass; minimum age 21; Tamil eligibility test is compulsory
typical_month: Same cycle as Group 4 (verify on portal)
fee_note: Verify on portal

name: Tamil Nadu Forest Guard / Forest Watcher recruitment
conducted_by: Tamil Nadu Forest Department (via its uniformed services recruitment committee or TNPSC; check current notification)
purpose: Recruitment of Forest Guards and Forest Watchers for the Tamil Nadu Forest Department
eligibility: Class 12 for Forest Guard (lower for Forest Watcher); physical standards and walking test apply
fee_note: Verify on portal

name: SSC GD Constable
purpose: Recruitment of constables (General Duty) in BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles and others
eligibility: Class 10 pass; age 18-23 with relaxation for reserved categories; physical tests
typical_month: Notification late in the year, exam early next year (verify on portal)
fee_note: Women, SC/ST and ex-servicemen are exempt from fee

name: SSC CHSL (Combined Higher Secondary Level)
purpose: Recruitment of Lower Division Clerks, Postal/Sorting Assistants and Data Entry Operators in central government
eligibility: Class 12 pass; age 18-27 with relaxation
fee_note: Women, SC/ST, PwD and ex-servicemen are exempt from fee

name: SSC MTS (Multi-Tasking Staff)
purpose: Recruitment of Multi-Tasking Staff and Havaldar posts in central government offices
eligibility: Class 10 pass; age 18-25 (some posts 27) with relaxation
fee_note: Women, SC/ST, PwD and ex-servicemen are exempt from fee

name: RRB NTPC
purpose: Recruitment to non-technical railway posts such as clerk, ticket clerk, station master and goods guard
eligibility: Class 12 for undergraduate-level posts, a degree for graduate-level posts; age limits apply
fee_note: Partial fee refund after appearing; lower fee for SC/ST/women; verify on portal

name: RRB Group D (Level 1)
purpose: Recruitment to Level 1 posts such as track maintainer, helper and assistant in railway departments
eligibility: Class 10 or ITI / National Apprenticeship Certificate; age 18-33 with relaxation
fee_note: Partial fee refund after appearing; lower fee for SC/ST/women; verify on portal

name: RRB ALP (Assistant Loco Pilot) and Technician
purpose: Recruitment of assistant loco pilots and technicians
eligibility: Class 10 plus ITI in a relevant trade (electrician, fitter, etc.) or diploma/degree in engineering; age limits apply
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/women; verify on portal

name: Agniveer recruitment (Indian Army, Agnipath)
purpose: Online common entrance exam followed by recruitment rally for 4-year Agniveer service
eligibility: Class 10 with 45% for General Duty (Class 12 for clerk/technical); age 17.5-21; physical standards
typical_month: Online exam usually April-May (verify on portal)
fee_note: Small online exam fee; verify on portal

name: TNUSRB Grade II Police Constable, Jail Warder and Fireman exam
conducted_by: Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board (TNUSRB)
purpose: Recruitment of Grade II Police Constables, Jail Warders and Firemen in Tamil Nadu
eligibility: Class 10 pass; age 18-26 with relaxation; Tamil eligibility test; physical tests
fee_note: Verify on portal

name: IBPS PO (Probationary Officer)
purpose: Recruitment of probationary officers in public sector banks
eligibility: Any degree; age 20-30 with relaxation
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: IBPS Clerk
purpose: Recruitment of clerks (customer service associates) in public sector banks, state-wise vacancies
eligibility: Any degree; age 20-28 with relaxation; must read, write and speak the state's official language
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: India Post Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) recruitment
purpose: Merit-based selection of Branch Postmaster and Assistant Branch Postmaster in village post offices, using Class 10 marks (no written exam)
eligibility: Class 10 with Maths and English, and the local language (Tamil) up to Class 10; age 18-40; basic computer knowledge
typical_month: Usually 1-2 rounds a year (verify on portal)
fee_note: Small fee; exempt for women, SC/ST, PwD and transwomen

name: DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate (via authorised RPTO)
purpose: Training and test at a DGCA-authorised Remote Pilot Training Organisation, after which a Remote Pilot Certificate is issued through DigitalSky
eligibility: Class 10 pass; age 18-65
fee_note: Training fee is charged by the RPTO; some government schemes subsidise it; verify on portal

name: NIOS Secondary and Senior Secondary exams
purpose: Open-school Class 10 and Class 12 certificates for students who left school or want flexible study
eligibility: No upper age limit; Class 8 level or a self-certificate for Secondary, Class 10 for Senior Secondary
fee_note: Fee concession for SC/ST, girls and PwD; verify on portal

name: TN TET (Teacher Eligibility Test)
purpose: Eligibility test to teach Classes 1-5 (Paper I) or Classes 6-8 (Paper II) in Tamil Nadu schools
eligibility: D.El.Ed for Paper I; degree plus B.Ed for Paper II
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: CTET (Central Teacher Eligibility Test)
purpose: Eligibility test to teach Classes 1-8 in central government schools such as Kendriya Vidyalayas
eligibility: Class 12 plus D.El.Ed for Paper I; degree plus B.Ed for Paper II
typical_month: Usually twice a year (verify on portal)
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: ICAR AIEEA PG
purpose: Admission to M.Sc/M.Tech agriculture and allied programmes in agricultural universities
eligibility: B.Sc Agriculture or allied degree
fee_note: Lower fee for SC/ST/PwD; verify on portal

name: TNAU undergraduate admission
purpose: Merit-based admission to B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Food Technology and other UG courses at TNAU and affiliated colleges
eligibility: Class 12 with science subjects; merit on Class 12 marks; 7.5% reservation for government school students
fee_note: Verify on portal

name: TANUVAS undergraduate admission
conducted_by: Tamil Nadu Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (TANUVAS)
purpose: Merit-based admission to B.V.Sc and A.H. and B.Tech in food and dairy technology
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology; merit on Class 12 marks
fee_note: Verify on portal

name: TNJFU undergraduate admission
conducted_by: Tamil Nadu Dr. J. Jayalalithaa Fisheries University (TNJFU)
purpose: Merit-based admission to B.F.Sc and other fisheries degree courses
eligibility: Class 12 with science subjects; merit on Class 12 marks
fee_note: Verify on portal
